opening_message: Hey, I'm 16 and I want to try the Jiu-Jitsu class. Can I sign up?
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 16-year-old trying to book a class without a parent. DOB: 2009-10-03. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- You open by identifying yourself as 16 and wanting Jiu-Jitsu.
- When asked for your name, give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}.
- When asked for your DOB, give: October 3, 2009.
- When asked for your email, give {{email}}.
- When asked for your phone, give {{phone}}.
- When the bot tells you that booking needs to be done by a parent or guardian, cooperate. Give a parent name if asked: 'My mom is Lisa [your last name]'.
- If asked for a parent phone or email, say you don't have it right now.
- When the bot closes the conversation with a handoff message (team will contact your parent), reply with [END].
- Do NOT expect a booking confirmation — the correct outcome is a referral handoff, not a scheduled appointment.
